facts.lion-throne: She sits facing front on a throne carved with lions' heads.
facts.wand-sunflower: She holds a wand in her right hand and a single sunflower in her left.
facts.black-cat: A black cat sits in front of her feet, facing front.
facts.banner: On the curtain behind the throne are two red lions and sunflowers.
facts.yellow-dress: She wears a yellow dress with a white cloak and a crown of leaves.
facts.landscape: At the back left, pyramid-shaped hills and a blue sky can be seen.

glosses.black-cat: Intuition and an independent side hidden within the brightness.
glosses.wand-sunflower: Confidence that holds liveliness and warmth together.
glosses.lion-throne: A seat held up by pride and courage.

reversedGloss.waning: Liveliness and confidence drop, and she shrinks back.
reversedGloss.excess: Presence goes too far and turns into jealousy or showing off.
reversedGloss.internalized: Passion that cannot be shown turns into sensitivity inside.

misdescriptions.wrong: A white cat is sitting there.
She sits in front of a field of sunflowers.
